gallery.title: 经典的回响
gallery.subtitle: 公共领域艺术数字展
gallery.subtitleEn: A Digital Exhibition of Public Domain Art
gallery.preface: 本展汇集已进入公共领域的艺术杰作：从维米尔的静谧窗光到葛饰北斋的巨浪，从梵高的麦田到修拉的点彩河岸。这些作品的原作分藏于大都会艺术博物馆等机构，其高清图像已以公共领域或 CC0 方式向全世界开放。我们希望用一座可以随时走进的浏览器展厅，让经典在数字空间中再次被看见、被走近、被凝视。请自由行走，靠近任何一件作品，灯光会为你亮起。
gallery.prefaceEn: This exhibition brings together masterpieces that have entered the public domain: from Vermeer's tranquil window light to Hokusai's great wave, from Van Gogh's wheat fields to Seurat's pointillist riverbank. The originals are housed at The Met and other institutions, and their high-resolution images are now open to the world as public domain or CC0. Our hope is that this browser gallery — one you can step into at any moment — lets the classics be seen, approached, and looked upon once more in the digital space. Walk freely; approach any work and the light will find you.

exhibits.title: 米洛的维纳斯
exhibits.medium: 大理石（3D 扫描自石膏铸件）
exhibits.credit: 3D 扫描：SMK – 丹麦国家美术馆（CC0 / Public Domain）；原作藏巴黎卢浮宫
exhibits.description: 1820 年发现于希腊米洛岛，是希腊化时期最著名的大理石雕像之一。女神从容的站姿与失佚的双臂，反而成就了后世对古典美的无尽想象。本展台的模型来自丹麦国家美术馆 Royal Cast Collection 的石膏铸件扫描（编号 KAS434/1），以 CC0 公共领域方式开放。
exhibits.descriptionEn: Discovered on the island of Melos in 1820, this is one of the most celebrated marble statues of the Hellenistic age. The goddess's poised stance and the mystery of her missing arms have fueled centuries of imagination about classical beauty. This model is scanned from the Royal Cast Collection at the National Gallery of Denmark (No. KAS434/1), released under CC0 / Public Domain; the original is in the Louvre, Paris.
